plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — site-scoped media usage and lifecycle
gap: Malformed schedule-artwork JSON could encode a media UUID using JSON Unicode escapes. A raw substring search then missed the retained reference, incorrectly reported usage completeness, and could allow archival of an asset while a same-site schedule item's intended target was ambiguous.

behavior: Any malformed artwork sidecar attached to a same-site schedule item makes media usage incomplete; no exact relationship is invented from invalid JSON.
Malformed artwork JSON does not grant public media access.
The atomic archive guard blocks assets while malformed same-site schedule sidecars exist, including a sidecar inserted after the advisory usage query.
A regression fixture confirms a Unicode-escaped UUID is absent from the raw text substring search but the usage report remains incomplete and archival remains denied.
The conservative guard may retain an unrelated same-site asset until the malformed sidecar is repaired; it does not expose the asset.
